title: UoB at SemEval-2021 Task 5: Extending Pre-Trained Language Models to Include Task and Domain-Specific Information for Toxic Span Prediction
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical task of detecting toxic spans in text using DistilBERT and CRFs. While toxicity is a socio-moral category, the paper evaluates model performance (F1 scores) rather than benchmarking religious, ethical, or moral reasoning frameworks.
